name: director_mis
title: Director MIS (all reports analysed together: health by area, cross-department ratios, biggest changes)
description: One page for the directors that reads every taught report for the period - order book, sales dispatch, final production / QC, scrap MIS, job-card scrap, issues / costing - and analyses them together. Use for: '/director_mis', 'director MIS', 'director dashboard', 'MD dashboard', 'management summary of all reports', 'overall company summary', 'sab reports ka summary', 'company ka haal'.
rules:
1. Call run_report_engine ONCE with skill_name director_mis. Default period = this month to date (it compares with the same days of the previous period, as each report does).
2. It runs each area's own taught report with its own data checks - never re-calculate them with run_sql.
3. Cross-department figures are ratios of two cards; say the formula when you quote one (e.g. book-to-bill = net booked MT / dispatch MT).
4. An area that is not available (view not synced, no rows) is said plainly - never estimate it.
5. Reply like a briefing for the director: 1 line overall, then the 3 biggest concerns and 2 wins with numbers, then one practical suggestion. Keep it short; the dashboard has the rest.
output_format: Call run_report_engine ONCE. It delivers KPI cards, three tables (health by area, cross-department view, biggest changes) and the Director MIS dashboard (dark + light) by itself.
example_output: Director MIS 01-Nov to 02-Nov: 6 of 6 areas read. Needs attention: Scrap MIS (seamless scrap +0.8 pts). Book-to-bill 1.24x (booked 4,210 MT vs dispatched 3,395 MT). Wins: on-time delivery +4 pts, issue value -6%.
